    """Checks if objects are outside the container.

"""Build the frozen-instance cooking-clear-plate trajectory."""
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from rcb_robolab import Session

OUT = Path('/app/output')
OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
s = Session('cooking_clear_plate', instance='/app/instance.json')
p = s.primitives()
q_cups = p['top_down_quat'](np.pi / 2)
q_spoon = p['top_down_quat'](0.0)
s.record_start()

# Grip one cup at the left end of the rigid two-cup assembly and carry it to
# clear table space to the right of the plate.
try:
    p['move_ee']([0.34, -0.23, 0.13], q_cups, speed=0.18)
    p['move_ee']([0.34, -0.23, 0.035], q_cups, speed=0.10)
    p['close_gripper'](20)
    p['hold'](8)
    p['move_ee']([0.34, -0.23, 0.20], q_cups, speed=0.12)
    # Keep the gripped cups low enough to use their bodies as a broad pusher.
    # Sweep the cup assembly from the left side of the plate across the spoon,
    # then release both objects on the right side of the plate.
    p['move_ee']([0.24, -0.36, 0.20], q_cups, speed=0.18)
    p['move_ee']([0.24, -0.36, 0.075], q_cups, speed=0.10)
    p['move_ee']([0.63, -0.36, 0.075], q_cups, speed=0.12)

    print('cup and spoon sweep:', repr(exc), flush=True)
p['open_gripper'](20)
p['hold'](20)

for name in ('measuring_cups_1', 'spoon_1'):
    print(name, s.objects()[name], flush=True)

actions = s.record_stop()

    'source': 'gen.py', 'steps': int(len(actions)), 'cup_grasp': [0.34, -0.23, 0.035],
    'sweep_end': [0.63, -0.36, 0.075],
})
print('saved', len(actions), s.status(), flush=True)
for name in ('measuring_cups_1', 'spoon_1'):
    print(name, s.objects()[name], flush=True)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Build the frozen-instance cooking-clear-plate trajectory."""
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from rcb_robolab import Session

OUT = Path('/app/output')
OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
s = Session('cooking_clear_plate', instance='/app/instance.json')
p = s.primitives()
q_cups = p['top_down_quat'](np.pi / 2)
s.record_start()

# Grip one cup at the left end of the rigid two-cup assembly. Use the held
# assembly to sweep the low spoon across the plate rim, then release both on
# clear table space to the right.
try:
    p['move_ee']([0.34, -0.23, 0.13], q_cups, speed=0.18)
    p['move_ee']([0.34, -0.23, 0.035], q_cups, speed=0.10)
    p['close_gripper'](20)
    p['hold'](8)
    p['move_ee']([0.34, -0.23, 0.20], q_cups, speed=0.12)
    # Keep the gripped cups low enough to use their bodies as a broad pusher.
    # Sweep the cup assembly from the left side of the plate across the spoon,
    # then release both objects on the right side of the plate.
    p['move_ee']([0.24, -0.36, 0.20], q_cups, speed=0.18)
    p['move_ee']([0.24, -0.36, 0.075], q_cups, speed=0.10)
    p['move_ee']([0.63, -0.36, 0.075], q_cups, speed=0.12)
except Exception as exc:
    print('cup and spoon sweep:', repr(exc), flush=True)
p['open_gripper'](20)
p['hold'](20)
print('after sweep:', s.status(), flush=True)
for name in ('measuring_cups_1', 'spoon_1'):
    print(name, s.objects()[name], flush=True)

actions = s.record_stop()
s.save_trajectory(actions, OUT / 'trajectory.npz', meta={
    'source': 'gen.py', 'steps': int(len(actions)), 'cup_grasp': [0.34, -0.23, 0.035],
    'sweep_end': [0.63, -0.36, 0.075],
})
print('saved', len(actions), s.status(), flush=True)
for name in ('measuring_cups_1', 'spoon_1'):
    print(name, s.objects()[name], flush=True)
